{{Quote|I don't like competition. I don't like you. The Devaronian girl is mine. The bounty is mine. Stay out of my way. If I see any of you again, I shoot you on sight!|Raije making his intentions known|<ref name="NoDis" />}}
'''Raije''' was a [[ZeHethbra]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A relentless and aggressive individual, he was hired by a rival of feuding [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Malkoi]] and [[A'jidre Skrigatov]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skrigatov's bride-to-be [[Brinaloy N'Vaari]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. During the job, Raije came into conflict with a team of amateur hunters, and left a trail of intimidation and carnage behind him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now there's someone I wouldn't want to meet twice. Crazy as a dinko and twice as mean. His name is Raije and he's some kind of rogue ZeHethbra. A big time bounty hunter from what I hear, though I never expected to see him in this system.|Malric Blaene on Raije|<ref name="NoDis" />}}
[[File:RaijeAgainstTheDevaronian.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Raije (in background) hunting Brinaloy N'Vaari]]
At some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="NoDis" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="EndorWhen">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[ZeHethbra]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] Raije was hired by a rival of two feuding [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Malkoi]] and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[A'jidre Skrigatov]], to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Skrigatov's bride-to-be [[Brinaloy N'Vaari]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. After traveling to the world, Raije's search brought him first to [[Al T. Nadder's Repair Shop]] in the resort [[City/Legends|town]] [[Le Yer]], then to the [[Unknown Pawn Shop]] on [[Phyrstal Island]]. While there, the ZeHethbra intimidated a group of aspiring bounty hunters also on the search for N'Vaari.<ref name="NoDis" />

Subsequently, Raije visited the [[Lost Loves Casino]] eager for a fight, driving off several [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] hired by Malkoi in the process; however, he eventually left the establishment. [[Bartender/Legends|Bartender]] [[Malric Blaene]] witnessed Raije's demeanor, and later reported his presence to the hunters when they entered. Raije caught up with the band of hunters at [[Njinska's Tavern]], blasting his way through the front doors of the joint and engaging in combat with them and the Rodians, though the hunters managed to escape the carnage.<ref name="NoDis" />

{{RPGseed}}
After the hunters secured N'Vaari and returned to the mainland in Le Yer, Raije marked the hunters as targets; though he agreed not to actively tail them, he would shoot to kill if he encountered them again.<ref name="NoDis" />
{{EndGame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I told you what I'd do! Time to party!|Raije exuberantly entering the fray|<ref name="NoDis" />}}
[[File:FistsOfRaije.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Raije (left) sighting his quarry]]
Raije lived for the thrill of battle, prioritising it above the hunt or wealth. He was relentless once given a target, and gave little heed as to what stood in his way so long as he could shoot at it. Even when not in combat, Raije seemed barely in control of himself, and exhibited manic glee when given the chance to fight. As such, he unnerved others and gained a reputation as a crazed hunter, and saw other bounty hunters as mere competition.<ref name="NoDis" />

==Skills and abilities==
Raije was adept in the fields of [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] operation, and was skilled in handling [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Missile/Legends|missile]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. He was also a seasoned melee combatant and brawler, and had knowledge of alien [[Species/Legends|species]], survival, demolition, [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming, and haggling. He was also streetwise and agile, and had a high level of stamina, as well as skills in climbing and jumping.<ref name="NoDis" />

==Equipment==
Raije carried a modified [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] with a blaster rifle attachment, claiming to have purloined the weapon from his first target. In addition, Raije toted a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], six grenades, and two [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. He wore an [[Armor/Legends|armored vest]] and a skirt, as well as [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and a pair of studded [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. Around his neck he wore a pendant and a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] featuring several small [[Bone/Legends|bones]], and his ears bore several [[Piercing/Legends|piercings]]. He also wore a spiked brace on his left arm.<ref name="NoDis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raije appeared in "[[Abregado-Rae Intrigue]]", an adventure for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Sandra Childress]] and [[Christopher John Parks]], and collected in the sourcebook [[No Disintegrations (West End Games)|''No Disintegrations'']] in [[1997]]. An optional incident involving an attack by Raije after the recovery of N'Vaari can be triggered if the players choose to return N'Vaari to Skrigatov; conversely, the ZeHethbra can be recruited by the latter to hunt down the heroes should they anger the crime lord by not returning his fiancée.<ref name="NoDis" />
